Who We Are

This website is operated by Plum Catering, a brand of [legal entity name — to be confirmed], [registered address — to be confirmed]. For the purposes of this policy, that entity is the controller of your personal data.

Data We Collect

When you submit an enquiry we collect the details you provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, company, service of interest, event details and message.

When you browse the website, technical information such as device and browser data may be processed to deliver and secure the site. Optional analytics and advertising data are collected only with your consent.

Why We Process Data

We use your information to respond to your enquiry, prepare proposals, provide our services, keep the website secure and, where you have agreed, to measure and improve our website and advertising.

[Legal bases for each purpose under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) — to be confirmed by legal counsel.]

Inquiry Form Processing

Enquiries submitted through the quote form are transmitted securely to our server and delivered to the Plum team by email through [Microsoft 365 — configuration to be confirmed].

Marketing communications are sent only if you separately opt in, and you can withdraw that consent at any time.

Cookies & Tracking

We use strictly necessary cookies to operate the site and remember your cookie choices. With your consent we may use Google Tag Manager, analytics and Google Ads conversion measurement. Non-essential tags do not run until you allow them.

[Full cookie list with names, providers, purposes and durations — to be completed once tags are configured.]

Consent Choices

You can accept, reject or customise non-essential cookies when you first visit, and change your choice at any time using "Cookie preferences" in the footer or the button below.

Service Providers & Transfers

We use service providers to host and protect the website and to deliver email, which may include [hosting provider], Cloudflare, Microsoft and Google. [Details of any processing or transfers outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the safeguards applied — to be confirmed by legal counsel.]

Data Retention

We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described above. [Specific retention periods — to be defined and approved.]

Your Rights

Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to be informed, to access, correct or request destruction of your personal data, and to withdraw consent. [Exact rights and how to exercise them — to be confirmed under PDPL.]

Security

We apply technical and organisational measures intended to protect personal data, including encrypted connections. [Description of measures — to be confirmed.]

Contact & Updates

For privacy questions, contact [privacy contact email — to be confirmed]. We may update this policy from time to time; the date at the top of this page shows the latest version.
